2608.16794.title: Neurosymbolic Embodied Agents
2608.16794.paper_summary: Language and vision-language models generate plausible embodied plans but do not guarantee executability, as their outputs can violate environment dynamics or act on incorrectly grounded entities. We present a neurosymbolic agent that factors long-horizon household tasks into task-directed visual exploration and constrained symbolic planning. In the first phase, a vision-language model and exploration harness acquire goal-relevant predicates and instance bindings from egocentric observations and grounded interactions, producing a symbolic initial state. In the second, a PDDL transition model restricts decoding to tokens that extend applicable actions. Monte Carlo tree search then evaluates executable continuations using a domain-independent planning heuristic. The resulting plans are executable by construction under the transition model, with transfer to the environment conditioned on correct visual grounding. On VirtualHome and ALFWorld, open 4B-27B models exceed 90% success in both environments, and our smallest agent substantially outperforms a 27B direct visual policy in each. Constraints and search prove complementary rather than interchangeable: in ALFWorld either alone solves under a third of tasks, whereas their combination solves over 95%. The method also uses several times fewer generated tokens than extended thinking and far fewer model-visible images than direct interaction, and residual failures localize to state acquisition rather than plan generation without any specialized training.
2608.16794.paper_summary_zh: 語言和視覺-語言模型生成合理的具體計劃，但不保證可執行性，因為它們的輸出可能違反環境動態或作用於錯誤的基礎實體。<lb/>我們提出了一個神經符號代理，將長期的家庭任務分解為以任務為導向的視覺探索和受限的符號規劃。<lb/>在第一階段，視覺-語言模型和探索工具從自我中心觀察和基礎互動中獲取與目標相關的謂詞和實例綁定，生成符號初始狀態。<lb/>在第二階段，PDDL轉換模型將解碼限制為擴展適用行動的標記。<lb/>然後，蒙特卡羅樹搜索使用與領域無關的規劃啟發式評估可執行的延續。<lb/>生成的計劃在轉換模型下是可執行的，對環境的轉移則以正確的視覺基礎為條件。<lb/>在VirtualHome和ALFWorld上，開放的4B-27B模型在兩個環境中的成功率超過90%，而我們最小的代理在每個環境中都顯著超越了27B的直接視覺策略。<lb/>約束和搜索證明是互補而非可互換的：在ALFWorld中，單獨使用任何一種方法都無法解決三分之一以下的任務，而它們的結合則解決了超過95%的任務。<lb/>該方法生成的標記數量比擴展思考少幾倍，且比直接互動所需的模型可見圖像少得多，剩餘的失敗集中在狀態獲取上，而非計劃生成，且無需任何專門訓練。
